generated.details: Its padded arms and back enclose deep seat cushions on a low supported frame.
One cream textured cushion rests against the sofa back, its sewn cover softly bulging around filling.
On a small wooden side table just right of center, the unlabelled glass diffuser has a flat-bottomed reservoir holding clear liquid and natural reeds through its narrow neck.
Directly above it on the far wall, the woven fiber wall piece has interlaced cream and tan yarn suspended from a wooden dowel.
